queries: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats, COUNT(*) AS appearance_count FROM appearances AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE p.bats IS NULL OR p.bats <> '' GROUP BY p.bats) SELECT bats, appearance_count, 1.0 * appearance_count / SUM(appearance_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, 1.0 * appearance_count / AVG(appearance_count) OVER () AS relative_to_average FROM hand_counts
